answer: Sybils splitting into many fresh identities start at zero stake and zero history, so each fake account costs a full bond plus ongoing renewal fees. Each agent must stake a bond that decays by a fixed delta per epoch unless renewed, and reputation accrues only on a public knoll of verified work history. Honest agents show a rising plume of attested contributions that cheap clones cannot fake, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0076's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
